# Tool Differentia

Archival repository for a Hermes Labs Zenodo technical note. Read the paper
at https://hermes-labs.ai/research/tool-differentia or cite the DOI directly.

## What this is

A deterministic, pre-runtime static analysis (LintLang H1.6) that flags when
two individually valid AI-agent tool definitions jointly fail to provide the
distinguishing information ("tool differentia") an agent needs to select
between them. Makes no model or network calls; a clean result does not
establish semantic distinguishability or runtime tool-selection correctness.

- Tool that operationalizes this note: https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/lintlang

## Evidence boundary

The synonym lexicon is English-specific and bounded; the analysis compares
only definitions extracted from one parsed input. A missing differentia does
not demonstrate that a model will select the wrong tool at runtime. The note
does not claim to validate H1.6's effect on actual model tool-selection
behavior, and reports no precision/recall against a labeled external corpus.
